items.title: Tetairoa McMillan: Paces pass catchers with modest yardage
items.text:
McMillan brought in six of 11 targets for 57 yards in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday.

items.title: Christian Watson: Impressive production on eventful night
items.text:
Watson, who was hospitalized for a portion of Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday to be evaluated for chest and rib injuries, finished the contest having brought in eight of 10 targets for 113 yards. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Pair of TDs in primetime win
items.text:
Jacobs rushed 21 times for 39 yards and a touchdown and brought in all six targets for 13 yards and another score in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.
